## Physical-control law without a thermal-noise oracle
For a real external digital light command A_k chosen with logged propensity pi(A_k|observed past), and arbitrary physical chemistry kernel K(dhidden_next,doutcome|hidden,A_k), comparing another randomized external light policy q with the same chemistry K gives
`dP_q/dP_pi = PRODUCT_k q(A_k|observed past)/pi(A_k|observed past)`
on complete action/outcome histories (under positivity). All hidden reaction innovations cancel; they are NOT actuated or logged. At one actual observed bound-state checkpoint W, independently randomize A=0/1 at pi=1/2. Horvitz–Thompson `n^-1 SUM W*(2 A Y - 2(1-A)Y)` estimates the **population that reaches this checkpoint** with contribution range [-2,2], so a valid two-sided Hoeffding radius is `4*sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2n))` on n independent full-specimen episodes. This does not identify responses of never-reached rare modes or chemical product fidelity.

## Tests at this actual scope
- `exact_repair.py` (this branch): exact rational 4-site transition matrix/absorption calculation, s=3/4, per-other-site q=1/20, delta=3/5. From four wrong sites exact expected edits `7560000880/1270238787 = 5.95163756...`, below analytical bound `20/3 = 6.666...`. All 15 nonterminal state rows checked.
- Full separately saved research bundle: 64-site simulation (s=.72, ASSUMED total c=.18, 800 trials) mean 39.638 repairs vs expected upper 41.403; 64 candidate 24-nt oligo address sequences with Hamming>=11, shifted pair runs<=8. Only combinatorial sequence screening, NOT thermodynamic NUPACK multi-tube (https://docs.nupack.org/design/) nor wet assay. The same bundle contains exact 4,096-case pathwise light-gating verification, negative counterexample when UV alters binding, and randomized physical light-pulse synthetic treatment estimate.
- Exact gate for external illumination: conditioned on an arbitrary occupancy path B(t) **unchanged by light before terminal reaction**, desired capture rate alpha*u(t)*B(t), off-target damage rate delta*u(t), and common exponential reaction clocks, the ideal measured-binding lamp u=B preserves capture hazard and deletes damage hazard at B=0, weakly dominating always-on. This coupling is familiar, and Action-PAINT already uses it. UV-induced changes to B, missed events, reversibility, and detector latency break the free-gain interpretation.
